novel_features.name: Published vehicle compatibility
novel_features.description: Compare your vehicle with one park’s published dimensions and membership rules.
novel_features.rationale: This uses GET /park/{kind}/{id}.html or the cached normalized record to compare positive finite vehicle measurements in metres, vehicle category and requested membership with explicit bounds and conditions, producing evidence-linked decisions with no external dependencies.
novel_features.example: kurumatabi-pp-cli parks fit rvpark/1086 --length-m 6 --width-m 2.2 --height-m 3 --vehicle van --membership nonmember --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Large-motorhome service-stop planner can act on explicit evidence and unresolved checks.

novel_features.name: Evidence comparison
novel_features.description: Compare park evidence without inventing total prices or unknown facilities.
novel_features.rationale: This uses two or more GET /park/{kind}/{id}.html records or cached detail observations to align dimensions, category, service states, fee text, membership and reservation conditions into field-by-park evidence rows with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pet-owning van planner; Club and nonmember tariff comparer can act on explicit evidence and unresolved checks.

novel_features.name: Waypoint proximity
novel_features.description: Rank cached parks by straight-line distance from an explicit waypoint.
novel_features.rationale: This uses cached coordinates explicitly extracted from official detail map links to compute Haversine distances from validated latitude/longitude inputs, report missing-coordinate counts and rank the observed candidate pool with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pet-owning van planner can act on explicit evidence and unresolved checks.

novel_features.name: Observation evidence audit
novel_features.description: Surface disabled-icon conflicts, stale observations and qualified opening notes.
novel_features.rationale: This uses a park's cached or fetched section evidence, raw icon alt/file state, per-record conditions and opening notes to run a small explicit rule set that emits conflict and confirmation issues with citations and no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Club and nonmember tariff comparer; Large-motorhome service-stop planner can act on explicit evidence and unresolved checks.

novel_features.name: Required-service screening
novel_features.description: Screen cached parks into proven, uncertain and ruled-out service matches.
novel_features.rationale: This uses cached normalized detail records and their raw proofs to evaluate a conjunction of requested service and membership predicates, partition candidates into proven_match, needs_confirmation and ruled_out, and list each predicate result with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pet-owning van planner; Large-motorhome service-stop planner can act on explicit evidence and unresolved checks.

narrative.headline: Plan Japanese overnight vehicle stops with explicit fit, facilities and unknowns.
narrative.value_prop: Search the official RV Park and Kurumatabi ecosystem, inspect vehicle limits and facility fees, then compare evidence and prepare a host handoff. Cached observations support proximity and required-service screening without claiming live vacancies or dated stay totals.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public search and detail require no account. The native search session is memory-only and is used only to preserve filter pagination.

quickstart.comment: Check the local CLI without network or credentials.
Read actual dimensions, tariffs and restrictions.

quickstart.command: kurumatabi-pp-cli parks fit rvpark/1086 --length-m 6 --width-m 2.2 --height-m 3 --vehicle van --membership nonmember --agent
quickstart.comment: Check published constraints against a real van.
Prepare booking contact and unresolved questions.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for official Japanese RV park and permitted overnight-stop discovery, vehicle compatibility evidence, service comparison and booking preparation. Preserve per-record membership, fee and opening qualifications.
anti_triggers: Claiming dated vacancy or an inclusive stay quote
Inferring outdoor-camping permission from an overnight parking record
